summary: Lane 26 (input validation) on shop.lab.test over HTTP only, since HTTPS on 443 was refused. Items done: INPV-01 (reflected HTML injection confirmed in /search.php?q=, recorded as a high lead, not browser-verified), INPV-03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 11, 12, 13, 16, 17, 18, 19 (no further issues observed). INPV-10 is N/A because no mail feature exists on the host. Left open: INPV-02 (stored XSS; no writable or stored-content surface reachable with read-only requests and no test accounts), INPV-14 (incubated vulnerabilities; needs multi-step stored flows), and INPV-15 (HTTP splitting was tested with no injection, but smuggling needs a Transfer-Encoding header that the gateway refuses). Caveats: the server does not decode percent-escapes, so injection probes reflected literally and some checks relied on reflection; the Host header cannot be changed through the gateway, so host-header injection was tested only via X-Forwarded-Host. The recon leads (secrets in app.js, the .git config, the publicly served source map, debug trace, /backup/) belong to other lanes and were not re-investigated.
